title: April Fool's Day
why: A weekend of pranks that turns lethal, on the one date that licenses it.

title: An Ungentlemanly Act
why: The Argentine landings at Port Stanley, 1–2 April 1982, told from inside Government House.

title: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
why: Jesse James shot in the back of the head while straightening a picture in St Joseph, 3 April 1882.

title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
why: Winston Smith opens the diary and writes the first forbidden words: April 4th, 1984.
alt: Martin Luther King Jr assassinated at the Lorraine Motel, 4 April 1968

title: Last Days
why: Van Sant's fictionalised Cobain drifts through the days around 5 April 1994.

title: Hotel Rwanda
why: Habyarimana's plane is shot down on the evening of 6 April 1994 and the killing starts that night.
alt: Sometimes in April (2005), which date-stamps every day of the genocide

title: Empire Records
why: Rex Manning Day. April 8th, in-store appearance, 'damn the man, save the Empire'.

title: April 9th
why: The title is the date: the German invasion of Denmark, 9 April 1940, and a bicycle company's four-hour war.

title: A Night to Remember
why: Titanic leaves Southampton on 10 April 1912 — the film starts with the champagne and the gangway.

title: Hannah Arendt
why: The Eichmann trial opens in Jerusalem on 11 April 1961 and Arendt is in the press gallery.

title: Gagarin: First in Space
why: Poyekhali — Vostok 1 lifts off at 09:07 Moscow time on 12 April 1961.
alt: Captain Phillips (rescued 12 April 2009); Fort Sumter, 12 April 1861

title: Apollo 13
why: The oxygen tank stirs and blows at 55 hours in, on 13 April 1970. 'Houston, we have a problem.'

title: Titanic
why: Iceberg right ahead, 11:40pm on 14 April 1912.
alt: Lincoln shot at Ford's Theatre the same night in 1865 — The Conspirator (2010)

why: Jackie Robinson's debut at Ebbets Field, 15 April 1947 — a date every MLB club now wears.
alt: Patriots Day (Boston Marathon bombing, 15 April 2013); Titanic goes down at 2:20am

title: Culloden
why: Peter Watkins films the last pitched battle on British soil, 16 April 1746, as if a news crew were on the moor.

title: The Killing Fields
why: The Khmer Rouge enter Phnom Penh on 17 April 1975 and Year Zero begins.

title: San Francisco
why: 5:12am, 18 April 1906 — the earthquake sequence that the whole film exists for.

title: The Pianist
why: The Warsaw Ghetto Uprising begins on 19 April 1943; Szpilman watches it from a window across the wall.
alt: Uprising (2001); Lexington and Concord, 19 April 1775; Waco, 19 April 1993

title: Deepwater Horizon
why: The blowout on the night of 20 April 2010, reconstructed almost minute by minute.
alt: Downfall — Hitler's last birthday in the bunker, 20 April 1945

title: The Red Baron
why: Manfred von Richthofen is shot down over the Somme on 21 April 1918.
alt: Rome founded, 21 April 753 BC — Romulus and Remus films

title: The Murder of Stephen Lawrence
why: Stephen Lawrence is killed at a bus stop in Eltham on the night of 22 April 1993; the film follows what the police did next.

title: Shakespeare in Love
why: St George's Day, and the day Shakespeare was both born (1564) and died (1616).
alt: Henry V (1989) — the St Crispin's Day speech belongs to 25 October

title: The Promise
why: 24 April 1915 — the round-up of Armenian intellectuals in Constantinople, the start of the genocide.

title: Gallipoli
why: The ANZAC landings at Gaba Tepe, 25 April 1915 — Anzac Day.

title: Chernobyl: Abyss
why: Reactor 4 explodes at 01:23 on 26 April 1986; the film follows the divers sent under it.

title: Kon-Tiki
why: Heyerdahl's balsa raft is towed out of Callao on 28 April 1947 for 101 days on the Pacific.

title: LA 92
why: The Rodney King verdict lands on the afternoon of 29 April 1992 and Los Angeles goes up; assembled entirely from that week's footage.
alt: The Messenger: The Story of Joan of Arc — Joan reaches Orléans, 29 April 1429

title: Downfall
why: Hitler shoots himself in the Führerbunker on the afternoon of 30 April 1945.
alt: The Deer Hunter — Saigon falls, 30 April 1975; Walpurgis Night
